# Memmy v1.2.401

## Highlights

- Fixed macOS in-app updates being rejected during CPU architecture validation.
- Corrected the seven-day skill-use metric to count recalls and invocations of activated skills instead of recently updated skill records.

## Agent and Desktop improvements

- Hide pagination controls when the User Memories list is empty.
- Fixed packaged Memory startup by including the `ignore` dependency.
- Updated Electron and SQLite runtime dependencies, aligned Memory packaging with SQLite 13 N-API prebuilds, and pinned standalone builds to Node.js 24.22.1.
- Retry transient HTTP 503 responses while the Linux systemd Gateway is starting.

## Upgrade notes

- The Linux CLI installer requires Node.js 22.23.4+ within 22.x, 24.22.1+ within 24.x, or 26.12.1+ within 26.x. Other major versions are rejected.

- Memmy Desktop and Agent are version `1.2.401`; the bundled Memory service, viewer, and CLI remain independently versioned at `2.1.7`.
- The skill-use total reports usage events, not the number of distinct skills. Updating a skill without recalling or invoking it no longer increases this total.
- Installation, in-place upgrade, signed-package validation, and publication remain separate release checks.
